# OSGi Liquibase

> An OSGi bundle that wraps Liquibase 4.4.3 into a self-contained service, allowing other OSGi bundles to run database migration scripts by injecting the `LiquibaseExecutor` component.

Key facts:
- Java 21 (Azul Zulu JDK), single-module Maven project with Maven Wrapper
- OSGi bundle packaging via Apache Felix Maven Bundle Plugin
- Embeds `liquibase-core`, `snakeyaml`, and `commons-lang3` into the bundle JAR
- Provides custom resource accessors for loading changelogs from OSGi bundles or in-memory streams
- Bridges Liquibase logging to SLF4J via Java SPI
- Part of the [JUDO platform](https://github.com/BlackBeltTechnology) by BlackBelt Technology
- License: Apache 2.0

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, architecture diagrams, and build commands
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Detailed developer guide covering directory structure, key classes, build profiles, and development environment
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup and contribution guidelines

## Modules — API & Resource Accessors

- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/osgi/liquibase/LiquibaseExecutor.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/osgi/liquibase/LiquibaseExecutor.java): Public service interface with `executeLiquibaseScript()` overloads
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/osgi/liquibase/BundleResourceAccessor.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/osgi/liquibase/BundleResourceAccessor.java): Loads Liquibase changelogs from an OSGi Bundle via BundleWiring classloader
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/osgi/liquibase/StreamResourceAccessor.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/osgi/liquibase/StreamResourceAccessor.java): Loads Liquibase changelogs from an in-memory Map of InputStreams

## Modules — Implementation

- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/osgi/liquibase/impl/DefaultLiquibaseExecutor.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/osgi/liquibase/impl/DefaultLiquibaseExecutor.java): OSGi DS component that manages Liquibase Scope lifecycle and thread classloader swapping

## Modules — Logging Bridge

- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/osgi/liquibase/logging/Slf4jLogService.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/osgi/liquibase/logging/Slf4jLogService.java): Liquibase LogService implementation registered via SPI, configurable priority
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/osgi/liquibase/logging/Slf4jLogger.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/osgi/liquibase/logging/Slf4jLogger.java): Maps Liquibase log levels to SLF4J (FINEST to trace, FINE to debug, etc.)
